scope: ALAMEDA-SCHOOLS CA2026-204..CA2026-216 final November 3, 2026 ballot status

primary_source.name: Alameda County Registrar of Voters — Candidate List (election: 'General Election - 11/03/2026 (Official)')
primary_source.how_accessed: POST https://alamedacountyca.gov/rov_app/candidatelist/ with electionId=260&categoryId=260 (Race Status and Candidate Status filters left blank) returns the full official list for that category, each race headed e.g. "Ohlone Community College District Trustee, Area 4 - Not On Ballot Vote For: 1"; GET /rov_app/candidatelist/260 gives the JSON race index (134 races).

corroborating_source.name: Alameda County Voter Information Guide, November 3, 2026 General Election (official, Registrar of Voters)

limitations: https://acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/candidates/candidates-list rendered 'Application Temporarily Unavailable' at retrieval; the working app is https://alamedacountyca.gov/rov_app/candidatelist.

No standalone certified-candidate-list PDF was found for Alameda's November 2026 election (Wayback CDX sweeps of acgov.org/alamedacountyca.gov returned no candidate/certified PDFs); the rov_app interactive list is the registrar's live official system.

The 'What's on the Ballot?' office table on https://acvote.alamedacountyca.gov/election-information/elections?id=260 lists all scheduled offices including Not-On-Ballot races and therefore cannot by itself prove inclusion or exclusion; it was used only to confirm the race inventory.

The Registrar app does not publish the underlying cancellation/appointment resolution text for these 13 races; determinations rest on its explicit per-race 'Not On Ballot' status plus exhaustive absence from the official Voter Information Guide.

findings.note: RESOLVED — NOT ON BALLOT. The Alameda County Registrar of Voters' official Candidate List application, election 'General Election - 11/03/2026 (Official)', displays this race (Dublin Unified School District, Governing Board Members, Area 2) with the explicit race status "Not On Ballot" and lists only these filer(s): HOLDEN LOMELI (Filing Completed, non-incumbent). Sole filer (Business Manager; Declaration of Candidacy filed 08/11/2026). The Registrar's system distinguishes 'On Ballot' vs 'Not On Ballot' per race (both appear as headings across the same result set), so this is the county's official final ballot-status determination, not a filing snapshot. Corroboration: none of these candidates appears anywhere in the official November 2026 Voter Information Guide, while every contested school/college seat does. Limits: the app does not print the cancellation resolution itself; it establishes non-appearance on the printed ballot but not by its own text whether the seat was filled by election-without-opposition/appointment (Elections Code 10515/9008-type outcomes are consistent with, but not quoted by, this source).
